youtube.baslik: What do the letters and numbers in electrode names mean? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Electrode sites are standardized by the international 10-20 system: the nasion-to-inion distance is divided into 10 and 20 percent steps. Odd numbers mark the left side of the head and even numbers the right; a small z marks the midline. So M1 is the left mastoid and M2 the right.
